segments.name: Live biotherapeutics
segments.description: Clinical-stage company developing novel live biotherapeutic product candidates to prevent infections and treat immune and GI-related diseases in medically vulnerable patients.
segments.evidence: The Company's singular focus is on developing live biotherapeutics for medically vulnerable patient populations to prevent bacterial bloodstream and antimicrobial resistant (AMR) infections as well as to treat GI-related immune diseases.

revenueModel.text: Revenue to date has been generated solely through the Company's agreements with its collaborators, all of which has been earned in the United States.

changes.text: In 2024, the company sold VOWST, its FDA-approved microbiome biotherapeutic, to Nestlé Health Science.
changes.evidence: We led the successful development and approval of VOWST, the first FDA-approved orally administered microbiome biotherapeutic and a Breakthrough Therapy designated drug, which was sold to Société des Produits Nestlé S.A., or SPN, and with certain of its affiliates, collectively, Nestlé Health Science, in September 2024.
